name: 56531 · Elbow Lake, MN
findings: ZIP 56531 (Elbow Lake) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56531 (Elbow Lake) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56531 (Elbow Lake) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.
